body:
While reviving linksplatform/doublets-web CI/CD in linksplatform/doublets-web#6, I checked doublets-rs as the upstream dependency to confirm the stable package to use. The current release is v0.3.0 and crates.io reports doublets = 0.3.0, but the doublets-rs README still says the crate requires nightly Rust and its install guidance still references an old pre-release version.

Observed evidence:
- GitHub release: https://github.com/linksplatform/doublets-rs/releases/tag/v0.3.0, published 2026-04-18.
- Cargo search: doublets = "0.3.0".
- README text currently includes: "This crate requires nightly Rust due to usage of experimental features."

Suggested update:
- Replace the nightly requirement with the current stable MSRV/toolchain guidance.
- Update install snippets to use doublets = "0.3.0".
- Optionally mention stable Rust in the quick-start section so downstream projects can rely on stable CI.
title: README still mentions nightly Rust and old doublets version
